The method sorts [lo, hi] pairs, then greedily merges each interval into the previous output interval when it overlaps or touches it (lo <= prev_hi); otherwise it starts a new interval. Output is a list of (lo, hi) tuples ascending by start, and empty input yields [].

Semantic boundaries handled:
- empty input -> []
- single degenerate interval lo==hi preserved: [[1,1]] -> [(1,1)]
- unordered input sorted first: [[5,7],[1,3],[2,4]] -> [(1,4),(5,7)]
- touching closed intervals merged: [[1,2],[2,3]] -> [(1,3)]
- nested/contained intervals absorbed: [[1,10],[2,3]] -> [(1,10)]
- disjoint intervals kept separate: [[3,4],[1,2]] -> [(1,2),(3,4)]
- duplicate points collapse: [[1,1],[1,1]] -> [(1,1)]
